independencePosture.honestStatement: Human-review independence on this repository is ATTESTED, NOT ENFORCED. Required approvals is 0 because GitHub does not permit approving one's own pull request, so a solo owner cannot enforce it. 'Require review from Code Owners' is enabled but inert at 0 approvals — it reads like a control and is not one.

deferredDecision.subject: Adopt Claude Code with the OpenAI Codex plugin (openai/codex-plugin-cc) for cross-model review
deferredDecision.trigger: Step 112 authorization of F1a — the point at which production code begins and code review starts to matter
deferredDecision.rationale: The mechanism reviews CODE. Almost no application code exists yet, and none of this session's actual defects were code-quality defects — they were governance, environment and search failures. Adopting now buys cross-model review for a phase with nothing to review.
deferredDecision.costReassessed: Initially assessed as a workbench migration. Corrected: the Claude Code VS Code extension is the same engine, bundles the CLI, and shares plugins with it, so adoption cost is LOW. Recorded so the original overstatement is not inherited as a reason to keep deferring.
deferredDecision.acceptedRisk: Owner accepts that the plugin places a second vendor (OpenAI) in the code data path.
deferredDecision.unverified: Whether the plugin's Stop-hook review gate fires in the VS Code panel rather than requiring the CLI.

whatIsNOTProven: No load, performance or concurrency testing of any kind has been performed.
No security review of app/main.py beyond a clean bandit scan. It is 40 lines with one endpoint, but it has not been reviewed by anyone other than its author.
No database schema exists. projectone_dev is empty. No DDL has been written, and the FR-010 check has therefore never run against real DDL — only against fixtures.
No real or client data has ever entered the system. Tenant isolation is designed and asserted, never exercised.
No deployment of any kind. OQ-13 is open, so no cloud target has been provisioned or tested.
Canonical steps 1-100 are taken as given from prior sessions and were not re-verified by this baseline.
The 360-decision verification figure remains not independently verified (OD-05).
Recovery procedures are declared, not tested. No rollback has ever been executed.
whatThisBaselineDoesAndDoesNotSay: It says: this ENVIRONMENT is verified and reproducible, and the gates that guard it have been proven capable of failing. It does NOT say the SYSTEM is ready — there is almost no system yet. Step 112 authorization should rest on the former and must not be read as the latter.

step112Readiness.authorizationRequired: Step 112 requires EXPLICIT OWNER AUTHORIZATION before Step 113. Never satisfied by silence, elapsed time, an agent's recommendation, or urgency.
step112Readiness.recommendedPrerequisite: Read whatIsNOTProven in full before authorizing. Every item there is a thing that will be true on the day F1a begins.
